description: This file defines the ConnectionId class, a Java representation of a connection identifier used within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes methods for generating, creating, and validating connection IDs, as well as handling dummy IDs.

classes.name: ConnectionId
classes.description: Immutable class representing a connection ID with validation, generation, and comparison functionalities.

methods.name: generateRandom
methods.description: Generates a new random UUID-based ConnectionId.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a ConnectionId from a CharSequence, returning existing instance if applicable.

methods.name: dummy
methods.description: Returns a dummy ConnectionId instance that should not be used.

methods.name: isDummy
methods.description: Checks if this ConnectionId is the dummy ID.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on string representation.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes hash code based on string representation.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the ConnectionId.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the connection ID string against a pattern, throws exception if invalid.
